mechanism_claims.claim_text: LL-37, WLBU2, and CSA-13 have in vitro bactericidal activity against H. pylori, with CSA-13 active at substantially lower μg/ml MBC values in both HEPES and Brucella Broth contexts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an MBC phenotype, not a direct membrane-mechanism assay.

source_locator.evidence_note: MBC values and Figure 2 support bactericidal phenotype.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CSA-13 retained antibacterial activity and mass-spectrometry profile after low-pH/pepsin exposure, while LL-37 was degraded under pepsin/low-pH conditions and WLBU2 lost antibacterial activity in low pH plus pepsin.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Stability/activity context does not prove a cellular mechanism of action.
